definitions.short: sprinkling ; hence, a sprinkling (or autumnal showers)
definitions.full: H3138. yoreh יוֺרֶה noun [masculine] early rain , which falls in Palestine from the last of October until the first of December, opposed to מַלְקוֺשׁ : Deut 11:14 ; Jer 5:24 ; Hosea 6:3 (where ᵑ0 makes ׳יו Participle, or Hiph`il Imperfect, but see We); compare also I. מוֺרֶה . See further Rob Br i, 429 f. Chaplin PEF 1883, 8 ff. Klein ZPV iv, 72 f .

occurrences.englishText: that I will give the rain for your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
